name: Brejo Grande (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms: a shield with an oil derrick, a palm, stars, a fish and waves, between sugar cane and coconut palms, under a scroll reading 22 OUTUBRO DE 1935 and over the name Brejo Grande-SE.
history: Brejo Grande is a municipality in the state of Sergipe, Brazil. The Wikimedia Commons image gives the municipal arms on a white field with the name beneath.
